data.description:
## Incident Overview
CI failing: test-plugin-scripts-no-relative-paths.sh fails with 2 violations.

Violations:
1. plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-create.sh:187: _wordlist="${TICKET_WORDLIST_PATH:-$SCRIPT_DIR/../resources/ticket-wordlist.txt}"
2. plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib-api.sh:788: _wordlist="${TICKET_WORDLIST_PATH:-$_TICKETLIB_DIR/../resources/ticket-wordlist.txt}"

Both scripts set SCRIPT_DIR / _TICKETLIB_DIR to plugins/dso/scripts/ and the wordlist lives at plugins/dso/resources/. The ../ pattern navigates from scripts/ up to plugins/dso/ then into resources/. This was introduced by epic 3e74-56da when the alias computation was added.

## Fix
Replace ../ path construction with parameter expansion stripping the /scripts suffix:
- ${SCRIPT_DIR%/scripts}/resources/ticket-wordlist.txt
- ${_TICKETLIB_DIR%/scripts}/resources/ticket-wordlist.txt
data.title: [Scripts]: ticket-create.sh and ticket-lib-api.sh use ../ relative path -> CI no-relative-paths check fails
